db:insert.doc:name: Insert Logs
db:insert.db:sql: #["INSERT INTO " ++ vars.tablesName as String ++ " (TRANSACTIONID, PAYLOAD, FECHA, ATTRIBUTESREQUEST, HTTPCODE, HOST, CORRELATIONID, FECHACREACION, APINAME, PROCESSNAME) VALUES (:transactionId, :request, :fecha, :attributes, :httpCode, :host, :correlationId, :fechaCreacion, :apiName, :processName)"]
db:insert.db:input-parameters:
#[%dw 2.0 output application/java
fun limitCorrelationId(value) = if (sizeOf(value as String) > 50) (value as String)[0 to 49] else value as String
fun generateCorrelationId(apiName, processName) = limitCorrelationId( "AUD-" ++ ((now() >> "America/Bogota") as String { format: "yyyyMMddHHmm" }) ++ "-" ++ ((apiName default "UNKNOWN") as String) ++ "-" ++ ((processName default "UNKNOWN") as String) )
fun getCorrelationId(value, apiName, processName) = if ( value == null or trim((value default "") as String) == "" ) generateCorrelationId(apiName, processName) else limitCorrelationId(value)
--- { "transactionId": payload.transaction_id, "request": payload.body_request, "fecha": payload.fecha, "attributes": payload.attributes_request, "httpCode": payload.http_code, "host": payload.host, "correlationId": getCorrelationId( payload.correlation_id, payload.api_name, payload.processname ), "fechaCreacion": payload.fecha_creacion as DateTime, "apiName": payload.api_name, "processName": payload.processname }]
